statements.t: Matt Meeker, Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer, commented , “Our team delivered a strong fiscal second quarter, with revenue above the high end of our guidance range, and continued to make progress on the priorities we outlined at the start of the year.
• Net revenue was $87.6 million, exceeding the high end of the Company’s guidance range of $83.0 million to $85.0 million.

• Adjusted EBITDA, a non-GAAP financial measure, was $2.0 million, a $3.4 million improvement compared to $(1.4) million in the prior-year period, which was in line with the Company’s guidance range of $1.0 million to $3.0 million.
We expect to decrease inventory to free up cash in the second half of fiscal year 2027.
We are reaffirming the full year fiscal 2027 guidance we provided in June.
For fiscal year 2027, the Company expects total net revenue in the range of $325.0 million to $340.0 million, and Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $7.0 million to $10.0 million.
For fiscal third quarter 2027, the Company expects net revenue in the range of $88.0 million to $92.0 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $1.0 million to $3.0 million.

The Company does not provide guidance for Net Income (Loss) due to the uncertainty and potential variability of certain items, including stock-based compensation expenses and related tax effects, which are the reconciling items between Net Income (Loss) and Adjusted EBITDA.
